mex_splitting.name: Mex Splitting
mex_splitting.desc: None: whoever builds the mex takes the spot. Map Assigned: the map's metal regions are dealt to teams at start, nearest first and round robin, and a mex may only go down in a region its team holds; needs a region layout for the map, without one the game says so in chat and mexes stay unrestricted.
